verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable server and CLI like Restate, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking or an opt-out setting. Self-hosting and single-binary deployment are adjacent deployment options, not a documented telemetry control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
